decision: reject as a general change: the NavierStokes Score gain did not generalize to Crypto, and neither fixture established an RSS reduction

source.build_command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo build --locked --offline --profile production -p quench-node --bin quench-node

research_and_hypothesis.v2_limit: Three-pair Apple M4 instruction microbenchmarks: integer add, multiply, and compare were effectively neutral; subtraction, shifts, bitwise operations, and double-multiply-add improved. This is not Linux V8-v7 fixture qualification.
research_and_hypothesis.linux_profile: One instrumented NavierStokes run counted 191,835,195 general Binary operations; 173,535,552 (90.46%) used the generic fallback. The profiler then aborted on its dispatch/opcode accounting assertion. Its timing is excluded.
research_and_hypothesis.candidate_scope: Reuse the existing numeric operator semantics for direct Number operands in the generic Binary path. Integer, coercion, BigInt, string, and exceptional cases keep their existing paths.

method.kind: alternating paired production-binary comparison against the same-source baseline
method.interval: 100000-replicate paired percentile bootstrap interval for the median difference
method.output_comparison: benchmark output with score and per-case result lines removed

node.coverage: All 20 binary operators across 8 numeric values (2,560 combinations), including NaN, signed zero, infinities, fractional and large bitwise inputs, plus object coercion, string addition, BigInt, and Symbol errors.

limitations: Only Crypto and NavierStokes were measured; this is not an eight-fixture or four-engine qualification.
Score and maximum-RSS intervals include a tie on Crypto; the NavierStokes RSS interval includes a tie.
